A7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The gains are K562 and RPE1; the target is A549. A5 bounds the transfer but does
not remove it, and no Perturb-seq of A549 at this scale exists on this disk.
CRISPRi knockdown is not the inverse of ligand activation. Knocking down a receptor
and activating it with its ligand differ in magnitude, kinetics and in which
cofactors are present, so A3 is a lower bound on what the signature could carry.
Pseudobulk averages over cells, so anything that depends on cell state is gone.
A measured gain is a STEADY-STATE response about 6 days after knockdown. The A549
plateau is 12 hours after a drug. These are different timescales and nothing here
corrects for that.
A2 counts an edge as covered when the regulator was perturbed and the target read.
That is coverage of the EDGE, not proof the measured value is that edge's gain --
a knockdown effect propagates through the network and is not purely direct.
